items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: Freddie Gould and them? When you were a kid, yeah.

ctx.x: Was he down in the Ninth Ward? Huh? Yeah. He down in the Ninth Ward? Yeah, Ninth Ward, yeah. Did you know Ambrose and Henry Ford and those guys and Freddie Gould and all those guys down in the Ninth Ward? Yeah, yeah. Were they playing when you were young?

Freddie Gould and them? When you were a kid, yeah. Well they, I don't know if they, they didn't, they wasn't, you know what I mean? They come up way after in the time, you know what I mean? Playing, you know? They come up way after. But the old man was.
